summary: Sandbach United are just one week away from kicking off the 2026/27 season and have been busy preparing with three new kits, several fresh signings, and a returning player to boost the squad. The Ramblers are actively seeking sponsorship opportunities as they push for promotion, and recent pre-season action against St Helens showed the team competing well despite a narrow defeat. With new additions in place and the campaign set to begin, it's an exciting time for the club as they look to make their mark this season.
